Mika: Midday async — quick check: onboarding alt-encoder-3 + eval regressions. TL;DR: eval job #245 flagged metric drift, PR #482 needs review, promptset v7 pushed. Please share short updates (what you did / blocker / today).

Ana: Did smoke runs on alt-encoder-3 with x100 subset. Blocker: GPU OOM during kv-cache warmup at 8k tokens, suspect batch tuning. Today: retune batch sizes and push tinyq config.

Raj: Triaged eval 245 — found tokenizer mismatch with new tokenizer release. Added compatibility shim in PR #483. Blocker: needs review/approval before re-run. @Ana can you sanity-check tokenizer change? :pray:

Toni: Left inline comment on PR #482 to lower seq_len in smoke tests. Small tweak. Also noticed CI flakiness on windows runner — unrelated.

Samir: Canary deployed alt-encoder-3:v2 to staging; observed +0.3% median latency but within SLO. No error spikes. Monitoring for 1h; will revert if regressions >1%.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment alt-encoder-3:v2 -> staging completed (2026-03-17 11:12 UTC).

Mika: Promptset v7 pushed to /datasets/promptsets/v7 — includes rewording 'clarify_customer_goal'. Please run evals against v7 before EOD. Quick command:

```
python -m eval.run --model alt-encoder-3:v2 --prompts promptsets/v7 --num=500
```

Ana: Ack — running now, will post failures. If >5% regression I'll open hotlist and assign.

Raj: Tagging @Toni to review PR #483. If you're tied up I'll merge after CI passes in ~2h.

Toni: I can do a quick review in ~45m.

Mika: FYI — if you hit kv-cache OOM, try `KV_CACHE_MAX_TOKENS=4096` in the run args. Fallback: tinyq quant and rerun.
